extras: Requires DataviewJS plugin to function. Development support is available via one-time donations or monthly subscriptions.
intentEvidence: Codeless Heatmap Calendar is a full-featured Obsidian plugin that generates a highly customizable heatmap calendar using data from the Toggl API.
problem: Users need a way to visualize time tracking data, such as productivity or billable hours, in a highly customizable calendar format within Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Fetch real-time data from your Toggl account with ease.
Requires DataviewJS for advanced data handling and visualization.

summary: A heatmap calendar generator that visualizes time tracking data from Toggl, allowing for extensive customization of appearance and functionality.
